y1: Because a large crowd gathered, Jesus got into a boat and sat down, while the people stood on the shore and listened.
y2: Jesus taught many things using parables. A parable is a simple story that holds a secret about the kingdom of heaven.
y3: The Path and the Rocky Soil
y4: Some seeds fell along the path, and birds came and ate them. This is a heart that hears the Word but quickly forgets it.
y5: Some fell on rocky soil where there wasn't much dirt. They sprouted quickly, but because they had no roots, they dried up when the sun came out. This is a heart that is happy at first but gives up quickly when trouble comes.
y7: Some seeds fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked the sprouts.
y8: This is a heart that hears the Word, but because of too many worries and greed, the Word cannot grow.
y10: But some seeds fell on good soil. They grew and produced a crop—a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was planted!
y11: A heart that hears the Word, understands it, and obeys it is the good soil. Jesus said, “He who has ears, let him hear.”
verse: “What was sown on the good soil is the one who hears the Word and understands it.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for planting the Word of God in my heart like a seed. Please let my heart not be like the path, the rocky soil, or the thorny soil, but let it be good soil. Help me to hear the Word, understand it, obey it, and produce a big crop. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: parable. It is a way of teaching a deep meaning using a simple story. Jesus taught using parables.
d1: seed. It is a tiny grain that sprouts and grows when planted in the ground. In this story, it is the Word of God. The farmer planted the seed.
d2: root. It is the part of a plant that grows under the ground to get water and food. It dried up because it had no root.
d3: thorn. It is a place tangled with plants that have sharp prickles. The thorns choked the sprout.
d4: good soil. It is soft and deep dirt where seeds can grow well. There was a large crop in the good soil.
d5: crop. It is the grain or fruit that a plant produces when it grows. It produced a crop a hundred times as much.
